description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication-related endpoints, including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with JWT token issuance and tenant-specific password hashing.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Endpoint to check the status of tenant salt configuration, returning whether the salt is properly configured and any warnings.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update a user with hashed password, automatically generating tenant salt if missing.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user, issuing a JWT token, with support for legacy hashes and tenant scoping.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Endpoint to reset a user's password, rehashing with tenant-specific salt and updating user record.
